name: Metaplanet
email_summary: No new material Metaplanet disclosures in the last 3 days; stock rebounded with bitcoin but governance/dilution overhangs remain unresolved.
bottom_line: No fresh primary-source filings emerged in the Sept 22-25 window beyond routine price action tracking a bitcoin rally. The thesis remains under pressure from the still-unresolved Series 10 option pool, MMXX Ventures transparency questions, and prior Capital Research/insider ownership-ratio changes reported previously.
source_conflicts: mNAV figures conflict across sources: bitcointreasuries.net shows mNAV (EV) of 0.77x and mNAV (Basic) of 0.57x as of ~Sep 21, 2026, while a company buyback disclosure from months earlier referenced mNAV near 1.03x; these reflect different dates/methodologies and should not be treated as contradictory same-day figures.

Share count and buyback progress: an August 3, 2026 TSE disclosure confirmed zero shares repurchased in July under the ¥75bn/150M-share authorization from Oct 2025, consistent with prior reporting that the buyback remains largely unexecuted despite authorization.
